vars are bound — so check-then-build was present and never got to answer no,
and every polymorphic reference rebuilt the callee's whole type tree
(Hβ.infer.instantiate-shares-never-clones). The check follows the edge now:
a bound cell holding no mapped var answers false and its subtree shares.
The opposite error was built and measured first — answering by the mapping
alone leaves a quantified var behind a binding unseen and severs polymorphism

of a Frozen snapshot compiles clean at census 0 every time and fails to
compile the wheel three ways: chase_deep intact gives OOM through
chase_row_deep/tail_set_union (a fold that ran once per decl now runs once per
use); a shallow head with a non-chasing free_in_ty over-quantifies the param
cells and exhausts a judge branch's mint band; a shallow head with a chasing
free_in_ty still exhausts it, because chase_deep is bounded at d > 200 and an

must agree) arriving as a bug.

THE ROOT UNDER ALL THREE. graph_compress_row's comment states it: path
compression is "an OPTIMIZATION WRITE", and a branch cursor SKIPS it because
a branch rebinding shared chain cells makes sibling chases schedule-dependent
(1,463 foreign row binds, the measured window-8 flips). Chase-with-compression
is a READ THAT WRITES; parallel readers cannot write; compression is disabled
in branches; branches re-walk uncompressed chains; that re-walk is the re-fold
that OOMs. The chase is not merely wasted work — it is what makes read-only
parallelism unsound.

Union-find with path compression is optimal for a single-threaded mutator and
depends on read-side mutation. Mentl has one writer, monotone refinement, a
flat handle-addressed image, and wants N parallel readers — there
canonical-on-write dominates and reads become pur

mentl/f030db5:
Two substrate fixes that together unblock multi-element block emission
in the wheel-self-compile cascade:

1. emit_body FIFO iteration via list_index (wasm.mn:1131-1140)

   The runtime convention is snoc-stack: list_head returns SEMANTIC-LAST,
   list_tail returns SEMANTIC-INIT. Per lib/runtime/lists.mn:9 docs.
   emit_body's prior recursion via list_head/list_tail iterated REVERSE
   semantic order — multi-stmt blocks emitted last-stmt-first.

   Substrate-honest fix per protocol_canonical_projection_pattern: emit
   iterates by index. list_index FIFO matches semantic order regardless
   of internal storage convention. emit_body becomes:
       emit_body(stmts) = emit_body_at(stmts, 0, stmts.len)
       emit_body_at(stmts, i, n) =
         if i >= n then () else {
           emit_expr(list_index(stmts, i))
           emit_body_at(stmts, i + 1, n)
         }

   Empirical: { 1 + 2 } emits (i32.const 1) (i32.const 2) (i32.add).
   Multi-stmt blocks now emit stmts in source order (was reversed).

2. ++→list_concat at 8 load-bearing lower sites (lower.mn)

   Bypasses the seed-time BConcat→str_concat dispatch gap (per
   docs/specs/simulations/syntax/concat-operator-substrate.md §1
   empirical state). list_concat is the canonical projection per
   protocol_canonical_projection_pattern. The ULTIMATE form
   (Hβ.syntax.concat-lower-specialization) restores `++` after the
   seed's lookup_ty correctly resolves TList for these handles —
   that handle stays named in positive form, holding pattern is
   substrate-honest at the canonical-projection layer.

perennials/f035b76:
Permapeople carries almost no pollinator or bloom information: fewer than 60
plants have a visitor tag and only 24 have a color. Enrich from two open sources
and expose both as searchable facets.

GloBI (CC BY 4.0) supplies recorded flower visitors. Group them by taxonomic
family into Bees, Butterflies, Moths, Hoverflies, Beetles, Wasps, Flies and
Hummingbirds. 3,900 plants come back with visitors; most of the rest are grasses
and conifers, which are wind-pollinated and correctly have none. GloBI rejects a
default user agent and its failure reads as an empty result, so send a real one.

USDA PLANTS (public domain) supplies flower color and bloom period for the
North-American species, which is the palette she actually plants: 1,038 plants
get a color. Only exact binomial matches are accepted, because taking the top
search hit would paint the wrong plant.

Both sweeps are resumable and their results survive the weekly Permapeople
refresh, which carries neither.

noodles/f0a60ca:
setContext() swaps the global AudioContext, so getTransport()/getDraw()
return the new context's objects, and the clock Loop schedules onto them.
But play()/stop() and the tempo/swing setup drove the deprecated
Tone.Transport global, still bound to the original context. The transport
that started was not the one the loop lived on, so the loop never advanced:
no sound, a frozen playhead, and a play button stuck reading "on".

Bind transport and draw to the active context once, right after setContext,
and route every start/stop/schedule through them.

The smoke test only checked the .clip.playing class, which setPlaying()
toggles synchronously whether or not audio runs, so a dead transport passed
it. Add an arrangement-view assertion that the playhead actually advances.
